Replacing components
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Use ``replace`` to change selected components without changing the original
version. Unspecified components are preserved; ``None`` removes prerelease or
build metadata. Unknown component names raise ``TypeError``.

.. code-block:: python

    >>> semver.replace('1.2.3-rc.1+build.2', patch=4, prerelease=None)
    '1.2.4+build.2'
    >>> version_info.replace(major=4, build=None)
    VersionInfo(major=4, minor=4, patch=5, prerelease='pre.2', build=None)

Command-line interface
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

The ``pysemver`` parser is also available by running the module directly:

.. code-block:: console

    $ python -m semver compare 1.2.3 2.0.0
    -1
    $ python -m semver bump minor 1.2.3
    1.3.0
    $ python -m semver check 1.2.3

``bump`` supports ``major``, ``minor``, ``patch``, ``prerelease`` and ``build``.
``check`` produces no output for valid versions. Invalid versions produce an
error on stderr and exit status 2. Use ``--help`` for usage information.

For programmatic use, ``createparser()`` returns the argument parser,
``process(args)`` evaluates its parsed arguments, and ``main(cliargs=None)``
prints results and returns an exit status.
EOF
